Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. It doesn't become your opponent's turn until the attack ends or you declare that you're not making an attack.
Card Q&A.q: I pay memory to digivolve into this Digimon. Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to attack even though my memory gauge is now at 1 or greater on my opponent's side?

Card Q&A.a: No, this effect doesn't ignore the ironclad rule that Digimon can't attack the turn they came into play, so you can't attack.
Card Q&A.q: I play a Digimon, then digivolve into this card on the same turn. Can I attack with it?

Card Q&A.a: No. You can activate this card's [When Digivolving] effect first and announce your attack, but you must activate all other effects before making the attack itself.
Card Q&A.q: If I have other effects that activate on digivolution, can I attack before activating those effects after digivolving into this card?
Can I attack my opponent's unsuspended Digimon with this card when not attacking through its [When Digivolving] effect?

Effect: ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
[When Digivolving] Unsuspend this Digimon. Then, it can attack your opponent's Digimon. This effect allows you to attack unsuspended Digimon as well.
